name: Handmade Archival Paper
description: Natural-fiber paper, hand-dyed with natural pigments and burnished smooth to create a lasting foundation for traditional sizing and gilding.

name: Natural Mineral Pigments
description: Finely hand-ground mineral powders including lapis lazuli, malachite, cinnabar, and orpiment—prepared for deep, lightfast color.

name: Shell Gold (Yellow, White & Green)
description: Genuine gold leaf meticulously ground into a fine powder and bound with gum arabic into a luminous, brush-ready paint.

name: Wheat Starch Sizing (Ahar)
description: Cooked into a fine paste, strained through cotton cloth, and brushed evenly onto paper to seal the fibers before burnishing.

name: Agate Burnishing Stones
description: Smooth agate stone tools (mühre) used to polish sized paper and bring gilded gold surfaces to a quiet, mirror-like luster.

name: Ultra-Fine Brushes & Compasses
description: Natural-hair brushes (sizes 3/0 to 10/0) for microscopic tahrir outlining, paired with precision drafting compasses for classical geometric grids.
